title: Senior SQA Engineer (Supplier Technical Support)
description:
****New Supplier Development \& Technical Onboarding****
* Serve as the primary technical interface and resident expert at new supplier sites during the launch and qualification phases of new programmes.
* Lead on\-site technical readiness assessments and gap analyses against IATF 16949, APQP, and customer\-specific requirements (CSRs).
* Drive PPAP submission quality by coaching suppliers through Part Submission Warrant (PSW), process flow, PFMEA, control plans, and MSA.
* Establish and validate manufacturing process capability (Cpk/Ppk) and oversee first\-off and first\-article inspection activities.
* Develop and execute structured supplier onboarding programmes aligned to internal quality gates and product launch milestones.


****Hands\-On Technical Training \& Knowledge Transfer****
* Deliver applied, shop\-floor\-based training in core automotive quality systems: APQP, FMEA (AIAG\-VDA), Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and 8D problem\-solving.
* Train supplier personnel in product\-specific technical requirements including drawing interpretation, GD\&T, material specifications, and functional performance criteria.
* Design and facilitate workshops tailored to the supplier's technology base — with particular depth in electronics and PCBA: SMT processes, soldering quality, IPC standards, AOI/AXI interpretation, and ESD control.
* Mentor supplier quality engineers and technicians in root cause analysis tools (Ishikawa, 5\-Why, Is/Is\-Not, Shainin) and corrective action disciplines.
* Build internal supplier capability in layered process audits (LPA) and mistake\-proofing (poka\-yoke) methodologies.


****Electronics \& PCBA Technical Specialisation****
* Provide expert technical oversight at electronics and PCBA suppliers covering SMT, wave soldering, selective soldering, and through\-hole assembly processes.
* Assess and validate soldering quality against IPC\-A\-610 (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies) and IPC\-J\-STD\-001 standards; coach supplier inspection teams in correct application.
* Evaluate bare PCB suppliers for compliance with IPC\-6012 / IPC\-A\-600 and review first article inspection of boards including impedance, via integrity, and surface finish.
* Review and validate electronic PFMEA and control plans for critical failure modes: solder bridges, opens, tombstoning, cold joints, pad cratering, and component orientation.
* Support qualification of new solder pastes, fluxes, and process chemistries; oversee SPC implementation on key process parameters (reflow profile, paste deposit, AOI escape rate).
* Drive appropriate use of automated optical inspection (AOI), automated X\-ray inspection (AXI/3D\-CT), and in\-circuit test (ICT) within supplier quality gates.
* Assess electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls, traceability, and handling procedures in line with ANSI/ESD S20\.20 requirements.
* Evaluate conformal coating processes (acrylic, silicone, polyurethane) for automotive environmental requirements including humidity, thermal cycling, and vibration resistance.
* Review component qualification evidence and manage supplier response to obsolescence, counterfeiting risk (AS6081\), and counterfeit avoidance controls.
* Support suppliers in establishing or strengthening quality management systems compliant with IATF 16949 and ISO 9001\.
* Conduct and lead formal second\-party audits including System, Process, and Product audits with documented findings and corrective action follow\-through.
* Identify systemic process risks and develop targeted improvement plans using lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives at supplier sites using structured problem\-solving and data\-driven approaches.


****Stakeholder Interface \& Reporting****
* Act as the primary liaison between the supplier site team and internal commodity, programme, and engineering stakeholders.
* Provide structured written progress reports, site visit summaries, and supplier scorecards to SQA leadership.
* Escalate product or process concerns with urgency and recommended containment actions.
* Participate in cross\-functional team (CFT) reviews, supplier business reviews, and APQP gate reviews.
